title: Why the China Coast Guard Matters in the South China Sea and Taiwan

summary: Over the last decade, China’s Coast Guard has developed into one of the world’s largest maritime law-enforcement agencies, operating a vast fleet of about 680 vessels. While it performs many of the same functions as its global counterparts — responding to emergencies at sea and enforcing maritime law in its jurisdiction — it is increasingly being used for a different purpose: advancing Beijing’s territorial claims.

title: Lockheed Wins $59 Billion Deal to Build Patriot Missiles
title_cn: 洛克希德公司赢得 590 亿美元的爱国者导弹制造合同
summary: The Pentagon awarded Lockheed Martin Corp. a $59 billion deal to triple Patriot missile production over the next seven years, as the Trump administration works to boost a munitions stockpile drained by the Iran war.

title: NY Prosecutors Focus on Trump Immunity in Hush-Money Appeal
title_cn: 纽约检察官在封口费上诉中关注特朗普的豁免权
summary: Donald Trump isn’t entitled to presidential immunity for “private conduct” that led to his conviction on 34 counts of falsifying business records in his so-called hush-money case, New York prosecutors told an appellate court.

title: Fed Holds Rates, Three Officials Dissent in Favor of Hike: Fed Special
title_cn: 美联储维持利率不变，三名官员反对加息：美联储特别报告
summary: The Federal Reserve held rates steady as the majority of FOMC members voted to hold rates unchanged, with three members dissenting in favor of a rate hike. This is the fifth straight meeting where fed officials have elected to leave rates unchanged. Talking to reporters, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh reiterated his goal to bring down inflation and but stopped short of saying he would raise rates.  Warsh said raising rates 'could well be part of that solution,' but not in isolation. Bloomberg's Tom Keene, Jon Ferro and Lisa Abramowicz discuss remarks from Fed Chair Kevin Warsh following the Federal Reserve's latest policy decision on a special edition of Bloomberg Surveillance. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump Says He’d Be ‘Disappointed’ If China Sends Weapons to Iran
title_cn: 特朗普称如果中国向伊朗提供武器他会“失望”
summary: President Donald Trump said he would be “disappointed” in China if they provided weapons to Iran, repeating assurances he said Xi Jinping had made to him that Beijing would not sell arms to Tehran.

title: Trump Unveils $20 Billion Plan for Washington Dulles Revamp
title_cn: 特朗普公布 200 亿美元的华盛顿杜勒斯机场改造计划
summary: President Donald Trump announced a plan to overhaul and expand Washington Dulles International Airport near the nation’s capital, his latest makeover project for the region, calling it a “long-overdue renovation and reconstruction.”
